name: Adamites
note: The descendants of Adam, the violet race.

name: Ancients of Days
note: The three rulers of each superuniverse, of Trinity origin.

name: Andites
note: The blended race of Adamites and Nodites that civilized Mesopotamia.

name: Andonites
note: The descendants of Andon and Fonta, the first human race.

name: Archangels
note: The high angels devoted to creature uplift and resurrection roll calls.

name: Associate Power Directors
note: An order of Master Physical Controllers that assigns and dispatches the physical controllers according to the changing energy needs of the realms.

name: Celestial Artisans
note: The artisans of spirit beauty in the morontia and spirit worlds.

name: Cherubim
note: Angelic workers associated with the seraphim in local universe service.

name: Constellation Fathers
note: The Vorondadek rulers of the constellations.

name: Dawn mammals
note: Small, agile, flesh-eating prehuman creatures descended from the North American lemur type, which suddenly appeared in Mesopotamia and developed a strong tribal spirit.

name: Divine Counselors
note: Trinity-origin beings who are the counsel of Deity to the seven superuniverses, three billion being assigned to each.

name: Energy Transformers
note: An order of Master Physical Controllers created by the Supreme Power Directors and Center Supervisors, usually one hundred per inhabited world.

name: Essenes
note: The separatist Jewish sect of Jesus' time.

name: Evening Stars
note: A high order of created beings serving in the local universes.

name: Finaliters
note: The corps of perfected ascendant mortals destined for outer-space service.

name: Foxhall peoples
note: Andonite tribes who were the first humans in England, retaining much Andonic culture and flintworking, and ancestors of the Eskimos.

name: Frandalanks
note: The most numerous order of Master Physical Controllers, jointly created by force organizers and power directors and stationed on all inhabited worlds.

name: Heidelberg race
note: A somewhat superior and prolific people whose descendants spread over Europe from the northern ice to the Alps and the Mediterranean.

name: Indigo race
note: The last and least progressive of the six Sangik races, who migrated to Africa and later experienced a great spiritual awakening under Orvonon.

name: Lanonandek Sons
note: The order of Sons who serve as System Sovereigns; Lucifer was one.

name: Life Carriers
note: The Sons who plant and foster life on the evolutionary worlds.

name: Magisterial Sons
note: The order of Sons who bestow themselves on worlds in magisterial missions.

name: Master Physical Controllers
note: The mobilizers and directors of physical energies.

name: Material Sons
note: The Adamic order sent to uplift the mortal races; Adam and Eve were of this order.

name: Melchizedek Sons
note: The order of Sons who serve as teachers and emergency ministers; Machiventa was one.

name: Mid-mammals
note: The prehuman species founded by superior twins born to dawn mammals, improved in every way over their ancestors and showing several rudimentary human traits.

name: Midwayers
note: Beings midway between men and angels, permanent citizens of Urantia.

name: Mighty Messengers
note: Ascendant mortals who survived rebellion and serve as messengers.

name: Morontia Companions
note: The friendly hosts of ascending mortals on the morontia worlds.

name: Neanderthal race
note: A people descended from improved Badonite stock; excellent fighters who spread from northwest India to France, China and northern Africa and long dominated the world.

name: Nodites
note: The descendants of the Prince's staff, centered in the land of Nod.

name: Paradise Creator Sons
note: The order of Michael Sons who create and rule the local universes.

name: Perfectors of Wisdom
note: A specialized creation of the Paradise Trinity personifying the wisdom of divinity, one billion assigned to each of the seven superuniverses.

name: Personalized Adjusters
note: Thought Adjusters granted personality by the Universal Father after experience with mortals, classed as the highest order of ascending Sons of God.

name: Pharisees
note: A Jewish religious party prominent in the gospel narratives.

name: Primates
note: The prehuman species founded by superior twins born to mid-mammal parents, who walked erect from birth; the direct animal ancestors of the human family.

name: Sadducees
note: The priestly Jewish party at the time of Jesus.

name: Samaritans
note: The mixed people of Samaria, ministered to by Jesus.

name: Sangik peoples
note: The six colored races that appeared in the Sangik family.

name: Sanhedrin
note: The Jewish high court that tried Jesus.

name: Sanobim
note: The lowest order of angels, assistants to the cherubim.

name: Seconaphim
note: The children of the Reflective Spirits, serving in the superuniverses.

name: Seraphim
note: The angelic ministers of the local universes, guardians of mortals.

name: Seven Master Spirits
note: The sevenfold expression of the Infinite Spirit, each ruling a superuniverse.

name: Seven Supreme Power Directors
note: The seven physical-energy regulators of the grand universe, created by the Seven Master Spirits, each in eternal union with one Master Spirit.

name: Solitary Messengers
note: The personal messengers of the Infinite Spirit, serving all universes.

name: Supernaphim
note: The highest angels, ministers of the central universe.

name: The Prince's staff
note: The one hundred Jerusem volunteers rematerialized to serve at Dalamatia.

name: The seventy
note: The seventy evangelists ordained to assist the apostles.

name: Thought Adjusters
note: Fragments of the Universal Father that indwell mortal minds.

name: Trinity Teacher Sons
note: The order of Sons devoted to teaching truth on the worlds.

name: Twelve apostles
note: The twelve men Jesus chose and ordained to preach the kingdom.

name: Twenty-four counselors
note: The council of twenty-four advisers on Jerusem.

name: Unions of Days
note: Trinity-origin liaison personalities, one assigned to each local universe as counselor and representative of the Paradise Trinity to its rulers.

name: Universal Censors
note: Trinity-origin beings who are the judgment of Deity, rendering verdicts in liaison with Perfectors of Wisdom and Divine Counselors.

name: Universe Power Directors
note: The controllers of physical energy in the universes.

name: Violet race
note: The Adamic race, the violet people of Adam and Eve's line.

name: Vorondadek Sons
note: The order of Sons who rule the constellations as Constellation Fathers.

name: Women's corps
note: The corps of women evangelists organized to minister to women.
